meta.revisionPolicy: Survey estimates are final on release. Each round is a cross-section; the two rounds are comparable by design but are never averaged or chained.
meta.coverage: All India and every state × rural/urban; average MPCE within each of the 12 fractile classes of that state's own spending ladder, ₹, without imputation.
meta.note: Each state's classes are cut on its own distribution, so the poorest 5% of Kerala and of Bihar are different people at different rupee levels. The survey publishes fractiles without imputation only. "Without imputation" is the headline MPCE convention (comparable across the two rounds); "with imputation" adds the imputed value of items received free of cost through social welfare programmes. Only the 2022-23 and 2023-24 HCES rounds exist in the eSankhyiki API — the 2011-12 and earlier NSS CES rounds are not served and are methodologically different; these series must never be spliced with them.
